description: 狙擊手（sniper）的建置配方：build_character.py 依這份檔案從頭產出角色。每個步驟的輸入輸出見 design/03-art-pipeline/CHARACTER_PIPELINE.md。
name: 狙擊手

design.prompt: Anime cel-shaded character art in the style of Studio Trigger's Cyberpunk Edgerunners: flat colors, bold clean black outlines, hard-edged two-tone shading, saturated neon accents. Full body, strict side view facing right, standing upright with the arms relaxed at the sides and empty hands, the far-side leg hidden behind the near leg. a sniper, tall and lean, about eight heads tall: a dark green-grey skin-tight tactical suit, a hood mask covering the whole head with a single glowing red scope lens over one eye, light chest armor plate, shoulder pauldron, forearm guards and knee pads in dark green-grey, thin red neon lines, black boots, dark gloves.
